scope: Static inspection of exact npm artifacts used by the three initial Harness Flows. This is not runtime or security verification.

packages.notes: Provides persistent memory and document recall, not coding or research execution by itself. It can write local memory, spawn a configured Mnemon executable, and check remote versions.
A local academic-manuscript integrity tool. It is suitable for research writing but must not be counted as a coding or UI-design executor.

Matches reproducible scientific analysis, but its tools can write files and execute generated Python or R through the DSH shell. Its local HTTP prefix includes mutating routes without an explicit same-origin or request-token check in this artifact; verification must not invoke them with user data.
Provides an authenticated loopback transport and approval gate. It supplies no UI-design tools until a separate frontend client connects and registers them.

Provides visual inspection and image tools. Some operations write artifacts, call local executables, launch a browser, or can send images to configured or built-in remote providers; the Flow must disclose outbound-image behavior.

coding-expert.reason: No required package currently provides a coding, review, repository, or execution capability; memory is supporting-only and writing-guard is a domain mismatch.

research-expert.reason: The capability set is plausible, but science-workbench requires isolated runtime, permission, route, and shell behavior evidence before recommendation.

ui-design-studio.reason: Vision is a primary match, but the bridge is transport-only and requires a separately declared frontend tool provider; outbound-image disclosure and runtime evidence remain open.
